## retry_policy

```python
def retry_policy(attempts: int=3, base: float=0.5, max_wait: float=10.0, retry_on: tuple[type[BaseException], ...]=(OSError,)) -> Retrying
```

Build a Tenacity policy: stop after ``attempts``, exponential wait capped, reraise.

## with_retry

```python
def with_retry(fn: Callable[P, R], policy: Retrying | None=None) -> Callable[P, R]
```

Wrap ``fn`` so each call runs under ``policy`` (default ``retry_policy()``).
